text:
marco: starting quick sync to lock alpha checks for observability quickstart. scope: single Overview page + trace metadata + admin CSV exports + basic alerting.
lina: UX will ship Overview with 3 compact widgets: latency p95, sampled cost trend, error-rate by route. No editor for alpha.
tereza: Runtime: emit tags model,route,org,token_count; default sample=1% + force-capture on error. Add header X-RW-SAMPLE for QA. Keep span metadata small (<256 bytes) and batch to telemetry producer.
chen: Ops: retention default 7d, full traces only on error or forced capture. Canary plan: 2% traffic, region=us-east, rollback if median latency +1% sustained 10m or telemetry lag >30s.
marco: Proposed alpha gates:
  1) Overview rendered for pilot orgs with sampled data
  2) Trace metadata emitted and ingested by pipeline
  3) Admin CSV export for 7d rollups exists (no PII)
  4) Error-slice alerts configurable and firing in test harness
  5) Canary + rollback doc in ops runbook
  6) Perf: median overhead <1% for pilot workload
lina: will add small tooltip explaining sampling and "why traces are missing". mock due Wed.
tereza: I'll file runtime RFC with PR checklist: feature-flag, span-size unit tests, batching.
ops-bot: ops-bot: created feature-flag "obs_quickstart_alpha".
marco: locking scope unless concerns. owners file short RFCs by EOD. sync Thu 10am to review canary and mocks. :thumbsup:
